brand.name: 光桌
brand.tagline: 专业创作者的 AI 生图与精修工作台
brand.sector: AI 视觉生成与精修桌面工作台

sentence.zh: 队列中 12 组 4096×4096 批次已完成渲染，双栏像素级比对与局部重绘就绪。
sentence.en: Batch 048 rendered in 3.2s at 4096px — compare 4 seeds side by side and inpaint.

set.name: 双栏游标 · Split Loupe
set.mechanism: 暗房比对台上的双栏游标：一道垂直校准线将取景框一分为二，统领几何无衬线字标与等宽数据排版，并作为深色控台上唯一的高亮游标青。
set.expression_move: 贯穿双栏视窗中央的唯一一道高纯度游标青（Loupe Cyan）校准基准线。
set.differs_by: 竞品（Midjourney、Leonardo、即梦）普遍采用暗紫霓虹渐变或星芒图标，Lovart 采用荧光酸绿配 Inter；本方案以光学仪器的双栏比对几何与游标青建立冷静的专业工作台辨识度。

logo.concept: 左右并排的双画幅比对框与中央贯穿的游标校准线，直接映射排队生成后的双栏像素级对比与精修。
logo.defect: 游标青在浅色背景 #f3f6f7 上对比度仅 2.30:1（低于 3:1 阈值），且中文字标高度高于拉丁大写高度；将游标青加深至 #007d8a 确保浅底对比度 >4.5:1，并在字标「光」横画切出游标微缝。
ideas: 双栏比对视窗：左右对称的厚壁画幅支架与中央游标切线，直接对应双图并排比对的工作台核心操作。
步进队列标尺：四道按网格模数递进的水平算力刻度槽，象征后台排队渲染的批次进度。
光学十字取景框：四角直角折线围合出无底色采样区，代表像素级局部重绘（Inpaint）选区。
分光棱镜切面：45度平行斜切块将单一正方形切分为输入原图与输出精修两极。
暗房放大镜（Loupe）剖面：梯形光学镜筒与底部基准高光线构成的极简工业剪影。

rationale.claim: 竞品抓取显示 Lovart 使用 Inter 与 #e1ff67 荧光黄绿，Krea 使用 Suisse Intl 与纯白底；采用深青与游标青（OKLCH h≈205°）避开竞品色域与 AI 默认靛紫。
界面含大量参数、队列与耗时数字，正文启用 Noto Sans SC 的默认等宽数字（tnum），确保表格与计数器不抖动。
以 300 字重配合 +60 字距的「光桌」字标传递精密光学仪器感，与厚重的双栏比对符号形成对比。

findings.message: light: link #0b3d44 on text #151d21 is 1.44:1, below 3.0:1 (links distinguishable from body text without underline (WCAG G183); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: primary #5a919a and accent #1695a3 are only CIEDE2000 6.2 apart; users may read one as the other

suggested_fix.how: lighten by OKLCH L +0.07, same hue

findings.message: light: link and text collapse to CIEDE2000 9.8 for protanopia (#373a44 vs #1b1d21)

suggested_fix.how: never carry meaning by colour alone (icon/label); or darken by OKLCH L -0.01, same hue

findings.message: brand and action colours span only Delta L* 24.5; without a clear light/dark step between them the palette reads flat (lightness contrast is the strongest harmony predictor, O'Donovan 2011)

suggested_fix.how: move the accent (not a locked brand colour) at least 25 L* away from the primary

findings.message: #007d8a is a mid-lightness trap: white 4.88:1, black 4.30:1; body text on it needs a darker or lighter derivative

suggested_fix.how: keep the brand colour for large areas/logo; put text on a derivative step of its scale

findings.message: light: border #cfd6d8 on background #f3f6f7 is 1.36:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.22, same hue

findings.message: dark: border #3a4347 on background #0d1316 is 1.85:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
Noto Sans SC lacks English auxiliary/punctuation characters: Ĕ Ĭ Ÿ ĕ ĭ
findings.suggested_fix: fine if the brand never writes them (loanwords, names); else another family

findings.message: Noto Sans SC misses 96/319 GF Latin Core codepoints (reach beyond the brief's languages)
findings.suggested_fix: matters only if the brand may add more Latin-script languages
